title: 5 Claude Code Features You're Missing
description:
Most developers use Claude Code at only 20% of its potential. Here's 5 features that can dramatically improve your workflow in just 60 seconds.

In this YouTube Short, you'll quickly learn five powerful Claude Code capabilities that experienced developers rely on: Claude.md, Skills, Hooks, Subagents, and MCP Servers. These features can help you automate repetitive work, customize Claude's behavior, and build more capable AI-assisted development workflows. If you're building software with AI, these are worth knowing.

In this Short you'll discover:

What Claude.md actually does
Why Skills make Claude reusable
When Hooks save you time
How Subagents improve complex tasks
Why MCP Servers unlock external tools

If you found this useful, subscribe for practical AI engineering content, leave a comment with your favorite Claude Code feature, and watch my other videos on MCP, AI Agents, and LangGraph.
